breakGlass.notAllowed: Open a break-glass grant from your own session in the operators’ tenant.
breakGlass.ownTenant: Break-glass opens another tenant, not the operators’ own.
breakGlass.tenantInactive: This tenant is deactivated: nobody acts in it.
breakGlass.active: You hold a break-glass grant to this tenant: it is never extended. End it first; a new one needs a new reason.
breakGlass.grantNotFound: No such break-glass grant of yours.
breakGlass.invalid: No break-glass grant of yours by this id is open: it ended, expired, or you may no longer use it.
breakGlass.expired: This break-glass grant has expired: it is never extended. Open a new one, with a new reason.
breakGlass.unavailable: Break-glass reads are not available in this build: the grant is recorded, but reads nothing.

actions.breakGlass: Read, in an emergency, a tenant that never invited you: read only, at most an hour, audited and told (operators only)
